rules.source: Approved Workbench v11.5 §6.1–6.5, V10/V11, I01–I06 and F01–F03, with C6 joint activation expressly deferred.
rules.rule: Compose one globally filtered and ordered authorized IE directory of three independent original domains. Preserve row, role and original way back; render the exact display price without creating a cost or workflow fact.
rules.initialization: Use the same existing adapters and schema, batch only the selected original row metadata, and keep bare and old deep links. No migration, retrospective update or duplicate status table.
rules.dateAndPermission: Resolve each original source with its own live read capability and same actor before paging in a read-only snapshot. Existing source identity, current round and quote versions, rush grouping of old readers and all prior business clocks remain authoritative; revoked/cross-tenant selectors cannot grant rights.
rules.expectation: Signed IE sees the three legal original types across pages, with the current returned row retaining exact prior price; click each legal original then return to the same page and focused row. The ordinary assigned IE saves a new exact price without clearing return state, then explicitly resubmits the exact original field via its existing command; wrong roles and malformed filters are rejected.

rules.source: Approved Workbench v11.5 §6.1–6.5, V10/V11, I01–I06 and F01–F03, with C6 joint activation expressly deferred.
rules.rule: Show only the released technical, size, material and style-image basis of the exact current IE row, and return the correct original craft requirement and style image without widening edit/approval rights.
rules.initialization: No new storage metadata or copied file. Approved source version and round determine the exact asset. Missing version has no fallback to another version, latest file, another round, or a draft.
rules.dateAndPermission: Authorize exact quote row or exact maker/approver version before each media grant. Verify original attachment class, binding, MIME and exact document membership. No supplier directory write, generic file read, new pricing permission or timing change.
rules.expectation: The original signed browser response resolves to the expected image ID and actual decodable signed bytes; an unrelated attachment and wrong document version fail. Original quote draft, exact receipt, technical handover and role revocation assertions remain.

rules.source: Approved Workbench v11.5 §6.1–6.5, V10/V11, I01–I06 and F01–F03, with C6 joint activation expressly deferred.
rules.rule: Use the same craft directory table and conservative original approval contract. Find authorized rows by order ID, accepted formal PO, customer or craft, and preserve current original state, exact unit price and row navigation.
rules.initialization: Retain original makers, master data and quotation versions; no activation or backfill. Unassigned/modality data absent is not given a fabricated factory or zero price. Old C6 approval paths stay usable under their unchanged scope.
rules.dateAndPermission: Native actor rules still decide whether actual line/manufacturer terms are visible and writable. Searching quoted rows is not access to wholesale supplier maintenance. Reject wrong actor, wrong version and direct bypass.
rules.expectation: Real maker uses true PO/customer search, original row and local return, authorized manufacturer, save and submitted receipt plus the existing legacy approval path; pre-R6 locks still reject new commercial writes.
